Results show that the alloy strength can be screw or edge dominated, depending on temperature and alloying. Typically, dilute alloys are screw dominated and edge strengthening becomes comparable to or exceeds screw strengthening in higher-concentration alloys when the misfit parameter δ ≥ 0.035 or when the elastic moduli are very high as in the W 80Ta20 alloy.
